title: Which New Orleans players are still around
summary: Asked about early colleagues still playing, he mentions Kid Ory, Pops Foster and Earl Hines, and that many stayed in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: You do it any time. Of the fellows that started out with you, are any of them still around playing?
Kid O'Reilly. Oh, of course. He's still. Fox Foster.

You know what I mean? Well, what about, well, L. Hines is a young one. Yeah. But there ain't a very many that's from that New Orleans guy. No, that's why I'm not. Because most of them are still in New Orleans. They don't want to leave home. And after they come up and stay a while, they get home sick. Well, you know, that's no good.
